meta.description: Learn languages with an AI reader, flashcards and a computer-based exam room.

localeSwitcher.label: Interface language
localeSwitcher.toggle: Change interface language, currently {current}. Switch to {next}

landing.announce: New: Quick filter vocabulary by CEFR level and topic with AI.

hero.title: Meet a new word, <hl>keep it</hl> for good.
hero.body: Read, select a word and let AI explain what it means in that very sentence, save it as a flashcard and review it right before you forget. Take mock tests in an interface just like the computer-based exam.
hero.note: Free for learners. No credit card needed.

loop.title: Every word you meet finds its way into memory
loop.body: No more copying words into a notebook and forgetting them. LinMaster links reading, looking up, reviewing and testing into one loop.

read.title: Open what you want to read
read.body: Paste text or upload a PDF, DOCX or TXT file.

lookup.title: AI explains it in context
lookup.body: The meaning in that sentence, IPA, collocations, CEFR level.

review.title: Flashcards that schedule themselves
review.body: SM-2 reminds you right before you forget, without piling up cards.

exam.title: Mock tests like the real CBT
exam.body: Get a band score, then reopen the passage to learn new words.

reader.title: Look up the meaning in the sentence you are reading

0.title: Select it, get it
0.body: Select a word or a phrase of up to 6 words. The same word in two different sentences gets two different meanings.

1.title: Quick filter by CEFR and topic
1.body: AI scans the whole text and suggests words at your level or on your chosen topic, with the original sentence.

2.title: A word bank that keeps the sentence
2.body: Each word is saved with the sentence you met it in. Search, filter and pick words to build a flashcard set.

flashcard.title: Review right before you forget, not just more often

0.title: SM-2 schedule
0.body: Rate Again / Hard / Good / Easy and the next review is worked out for you. A daily card limit keeps reviews from piling up.

1.title: Quizlet-style set editor
1.body: Add, delete and reorder cards, or build a set straight from your word bank.

2.title: Test, match and AI practice
2.body: More ways to review beyond flipping cards, so words stick.

exam.title: An exam room like the real CBT, with your own tests

0.title: Drop in test files (PDF, audio)
0.body: AI recognises the test structure, the system checks every question is there, then builds a private exam room for you.

1.title: Highlight, notes, strike out options
1.body: The same tools as the computer at the test centre: highlight, take notes, flag questions for review.

2.title: Band score and weak spots
2.body: Scored the moment you submit, converted to a band, with every wrong answer and the question types you struggle with.

dashboard.title: See your progress at a glance
dashboard.body: Activity calendar, study streak, band trend and the question types you are still weak at.

final.title: From your first passage to your target band

footer.tagline: Learn English vocabulary in context and practise for the computer-based IELTS.
